# Kitchen Table Worksheets

> Printable worksheets and coloring pages for children from pre-K to grade 8 (ages 3 to 13). An app for iPhone, iPad and Android, and free pages on this site. Made to be printed and done on paper, at the table, with a grown-up nearby.

- 1,921 worksheets and 604 coloring pages in 22 subjects: Math, English, Science, Social Studies, Computing, Life Skills, Art, Music, Games, Coloring, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Hebrew, Arabic, Japanese, ASL, Russian, Hindi, Greek, Turkish, Toolkit.
- 314 of them are free on this site: the first two of every pack. No account, no email, no watermark. Each has its own page with a Print button.
- The app is free to download and holds the same free pages. One payment, made once, opens the rest. It is not a subscription. No ads and no account. The store listing shows the price.
- In the app, most worksheets print with an answer key on a page of its own. The free pages on this site come without the key.
- Everything prints in black and white on an ordinary home printer, and is written in American English.
- Made by Wilcodes LLC, a one-person company. Contact: hello@ktworksheets.com

## Get the app

- [Kitchen Table Worksheets on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/kitchen-table-worksheets/id6817992308): iPhone and iPad

## Free Math printables

- [Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math.html): every free Math page
- [Pre-K Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-04-prek.html): age 4. Writing digits, then what they mean: counting, ten frames, order, comparing, adding and taking away. Plus shape, position and data.
- [Kindergarten Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-05-kinder.html): age 5. Counting to 100, addition and subtraction within 10 without pictures, teen numbers as ten-and-some, and 3D shapes.
- [Grade 1 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-06-grade1.html): age 6. Fluency within 20, place value to 120, and the first real measurement and time work.
- [Grade 2 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-07-grade2.html): age 7. Add and subtract within 100 with regrouping, place value to 1000, money and time — and arrays, which is where multiplication starts.
- [Grade 3 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-08-grade3.html): age 8. The full year: place value, add and subtract to 1,000, multiplication and division, fractions, measurement, data and geometry.
- [Grade 4 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-09-grade4.html): age 9. Multi-digit multiplication and long division, equivalent fractions, and decimals arrive.
- [Grade 5 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-10-grade5.html): age 10. Decimal arithmetic, fractions with unlike denominators, volume and the coordinate plane.
- [Grade 6 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-11-grade6.html): age 11. Ratios and rates, negative numbers, and a letter that stands for a number — the year arithmetic turns into algebra.
- [Grade 7 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-12-grade7.html): age 12. Proportional relationships and the constant inside them, arithmetic with negative numbers, two-step equations, and circles.
- [Grade 8 Math](https://ktworksheets.com/free/math-13-grade8.html): age 13. Lines become functions, exponents get rules, shapes move — and the last year before algebra I.

## Free English printables

- [English](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english.html): every free English page
- [Pre-K Literacy](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-04-prek.html): age 4. Letters from the strokes up, their own name, first words and sentences, then phonics. Plus cutting, recognition and games.
- [What They Did Not Know](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-04-read-aloud-lives.html): ages 4 to 7. Short stories a grown-up reads aloud, each with four questions the child answers out loud.
- [Any Book](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-05-any-book.html): ages 5 and up. The half a worksheet cannot do. A log, a read-aloud list, and response sheets that work with whatever book is actually in the house — including the one about tractors, again.
- [Kindergarten Literacy](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-05-kinder.html): age 5. The year reading starts: every letter sound, blending CVC words, the first sight words, and writing a sentence that someone else can read.
- [Nobody Is Reading It To You](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-05-reading-alone.html): ages 5 and up. Twelve stories a child reads alone, and not one word in any of them has gone untaught.
- [Writing About Your Own Day](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-06-daily-writing.html): ages 6 and up. Writing assignments where the subject is the thing the child already knows best and has never once looked at: the morning, the walk, the bedtime, the room, the people in the house.
- [Grade 1 Reading & Writing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-06-grade1.html): age 6. Digraphs, blends and silent e take reading past three-letter words. Writing moves from one sentence to a few that belong together.
- [Printing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-06-printing.html): ages 6 and up. The letters again, but grouped by how the pencil moves rather than by the alphabet — and then the four things that actually go wrong at six: size, the line, spaces, and capitals in the middle of…
- [Grade 2 Reading & Writing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-07-grade2.html): age 7. Longer words come apart into syllables, prefixes and suffixes appear, and writing becomes paragraphs.
- [Grade 2 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-07-grade2-daily-language.html): age 7. Eight sets of ten broken sentences, ten minutes each.
- [Nobody Does Anything For No Reason](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-08-character-motive.html): ages 8 and up. Reading passages about people whose behavior makes no sense until you know what they believe.
- [Cursive](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-08-cursive.html): age 8. Not twenty-six curly shapes in boxes. The pen does not lift, so what happens BETWEEN two letters is a stroke of its own — and five letters finish at the top, which is why ou and au do not match.
- [Grade 3 Daily Language](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-08-grade3-daily-language.html): age 8. The testing half: ten sets of sentence editing, with answer keys.
- [Grade 3 Reading](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-08-grade3-reading.html): age 8. The teaching half of English: grammar, vocabulary, spelling, comprehension, writing and poetry.
- [Grade 4 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-09-grade4-daily-language.html): age 9. Eight sets of ten broken sentences. A set takes ten minutes and doubles as a thermometer: whatever cannot be fixed is the sheet to go and teach.
- [Grade 4 Reading & Writing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-09-grade4-reading.html): age 9. Reading for theme and evidence rather than plot, and writing essays with structure.
- [Grade 5 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-10-grade5-daily-language.html): age 10. Eight sets of ten broken sentences. A set takes ten minutes and doubles as a thermometer: whatever cannot be fixed is the sheet to go and teach.
- [Grade 5 Reading & Writing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-10-grade5-reading.html): age 10. Comparing accounts, research, and essays that hold an argument.
- [Reading Closely — Any Book](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-close-reading.html): ages 11 and up. Somebody made this, and you can catch them doing it. Thirteen sheets that work with whatever novel is actually in the house.
- [Grade 6 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-grade6-daily-language.html): age 11. Eight sets of ten broken sentences. A set takes ten minutes and doubles as a thermometer: whatever cannot be fixed is the sheet to go and teach.
- [Grade 6 Grammar](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-grade6-grammar.html): age 11. Pronouns, the three sentence shapes, and punctuation for the part you could lift out.
- [Grade 6 Reading](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-grade6-reading.html): age 11. Nonfiction, and how a text is BUILT — topic against point, the four shapes a paragraph comes in, what the numbers are doing, and the sentence carrying the claim.
- [Any Poem](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-poetry.html): ages 11 and up. Twelve sheets that work with whatever poem is in front of you — read closely, because a poem is short enough to read twice.
- [The Second Draft](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-revising.html): ages 11 and up. A piece of writing is a thing you change, and every change has a name. Cut, reorder, replace — on somebody else's draft first, then on your own.
- [Where Words Come From](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-11-word-origins.html): ages 11 and up. Sixty roots that unlock a few thousand words, and the reason English spells the way it does rather than the way it sounds.
- [Grade 7 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-12-grade7-daily-language.html): age 12. Eight sets of ten broken sentences. A set takes ten minutes and doubles as a thermometer: whatever cannot be fixed is the sheet to go and teach.
- [Grade 7 Grammar](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-12-grade7-grammar.html): age 12. Phrases and clauses, the four sentence types, and modifiers that attach to the wrong thing.
- [Grade 7 Reading](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-12-grade7-reading.html): age 12. What a text is ARGUING — claim, evidence and reasoning as three things that fail separately, and the difference between disagreeing with a conclusion and finding a fault in it.
- [Grade 8 Daily Language Review](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-13-grade8-daily-language.html): age 13. Eight sets of ten broken sentences. A set takes ten minutes and doubles as a thermometer: whatever cannot be fixed is the sheet to go and teach.
- [Grade 8 Grammar](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-13-grade8-grammar.html): age 13. Verbals, active and passive voice, and mood — the year grammar starts being about who is being hidden.
- [Grade 8 Reading](https://ktworksheets.com/free/english-13-grade8-reading.html): age 13. Two texts on one subject, held side by side — what both say, where they differ, what neither mentions, and who wrote them.

## Free Science printables

- [Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science.html): every free Science page
- [Field Guide](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-00-field-guide.html): any age. Charts for telling one kind from another — the dog on the other side of the park, the tree at the end of the road.
- [Why the Year Does That](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-00-the-year.html): any age. The questions a child actually asks in October and December, and almost never gets answered.
- [Pre-K World](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-04-prek.html): age 4. My body and my senses, the weather and the seasons, what is alive — and the two kinds of order: what has to happen first, and the seven days that come back round.
- [Kindergarten World](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-05-kinder.html): age 5. Where animals live, what plants need, pushes and pulls, and the sun and the moon taking turns.
- [Grade 1 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-06-grade1.html): age 6. Light and sound, the parts of plants and animals, and patterns in the sky.
- [How a Body Keeps Working](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-06-human-body.html): ages 6 and up. Not a food pyramid to copy out. What food is actually FOR, why sleep is not optional, why teeth are different from every other part of you, what soap does to a germ, and how a muscle can only pull.
- [Grade 2 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-07-grade2.html): age 7. States of matter, habitats, life cycles, and how land changes.
- [The Same Water](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-07-water-cycle.html): ages 7 and up. There is no new water. What is here has been here since before there were animals to drink it, and it has been round and round — sea, cloud, river, tap, you, drain, sea.
- [Nothing Is Colored](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-08-colour-and-light.html): ages 8 and up. A red apple is not red. It swallows every color except red and throws that one back, which is why a green apple goes black under a red torch.
- [What Are You Actually Eating?](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-08-food.html): ages 8 and up. Six keys to the food on your plate — vegetables, fruit, nuts, spices, dairy and meat — and one word used properly.
- [What the Ground Is Made Of](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-08-geology.html): ages 8 and up. Every rock you can pick up is a record of how it was made, and you can read most of it in your hand.
- [Grade 3 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-08-grade3.html): age 8. Forces, life cycles, weather, ecosystems, matter and energy, earth and space.
- [Why the Sky Is Doing That](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-08-weather.html): ages 8 and up. If the sun heated the earth evenly there would be no weather at all.
- [Grade 4 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-09-grade4.html): age 9. Energy, waves, structure and function, and how the earth changes.
- [Kitchen Chemistry](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-09-kitchen-chemistry.html): ages 9 and up. The half of chemistry the science packs do not reach, done with red cabbage, vinegar and a jar.
- [Nothing but Light](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-09-light-and-astronomy.html): ages 9 and up. The sky you can walk outside and see, and how anybody knows anything about it.
- [Nothing Was Watching](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-10-geologic-time.html): ages 10 and up. How anybody knows the age of something nobody saw happen.
- [Grade 5 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-10-grade5.html): age 10. Matter and chemical change, ecosystems as systems, and the solar system.
- [What Keeps a Body Working](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-11-body-at-eleven.html): age 11. The rung above naming the parts. Three mechanisms that are genuinely surprising and are almost never explained: why most of feeling ill is your own body rather than the germ, why not finishing the…
- [Why Anything Sticks Together](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-11-chemical-bonding.html): ages 11 and up. The elements you actually meet, and then the thing no sheet on this shelf could explain: why a metal that burns in water and a gas that poisons you make the salt on your chips.
- [Grade 6 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-11-grade6.html): age 11. Particles, heat, the engine inside the earth, and cells — four years of science facts finally get their mechanism.
- [How Do You Know?](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-11-scientific-method.html): ages 11 and up. Taking an experiment apart, and then taking an advert apart with the same tools. Thirteen sheets, no lab required.
- [Grade 7 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-12-grade7.html): age 12. The life year — a body as a transport problem, the two energy equations, why offspring resemble their parents, and what that does over a very long time.
- [Grade 8 Science](https://ktworksheets.com/free/science-13-grade8.html): age 13. Atoms and the list they fall into, reactions that have to balance, forces that only change motion, and one family of waves.

## Free Social Studies printables

- [Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social.html): every free Social Studies page
- [Home and Street](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-04-home-and-street.html): ages 4 and up. Social studies before any of it is abstract: who lives in this house, what the grown-ups a child can actually see do all day, one room drawn from above, one rule with a reason, and whose turn it is on…
- [Grade 1 Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-06-grade1.html): age 6. Maps and globes, community helpers, needs and wants, and time lines.
- [Grade 2 Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-07-grade2.html): age 7. Government close to home, goods and services, and other cultures.
- [Grade 3 Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-08-grade3.html): age 8. Maps, communities, government, economics, geography and history.
- [How Anybody Knows](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-09-ancient-world.html): ages 9 and up. The ancient world, taught as a question rather than a list: how long ago it really was when you draw it to scale, why the first writing anybody invented was a receipt, why every early city is on a…
- [Grade 4 Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-09-grade4.html): age 9. State history and geography, regions, and how government works.
- [Why Is It Like That There](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-09-physical-geography.html): ages 9 and up. Not a sheet per continent — "Africa" is not a topic, it is fifty-four countries and every climate there is, and a sheet with a region at the top can only be a list of capitals and a flag to color.
- [The Shape of the World](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-09-world-geography.html): ages 9 and up. What a flat map does to a round planet, and how to measure the thing anyway.
- [Grade 5 Social Studies](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-10-grade5.html): age 10. United States history from first peoples to the constitution.
- [The Second Number](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-11-economics.html): ages 11 and up. Every offer has a number they show you and a number that is true.
- [Why Then and Not Earlier](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-11-why-then.html): age 11. Not a list of inventions with dates beside them.
- [The Map Is Younger Than You Think](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-12-the-young-map.html): age 12. A world map looks like a fact about the planet.
- [What Survived, and What It Leaves Out](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-12-what-survived.html): age 12. social-09-ancient-world asked at nine which things would still be here in three thousand years.
- [Where Things Come From](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-12-where-things-come-from.html): age 12. Nothing in your house was made in one place, and that is recent and deliberate rather than natural.
- [Why It Stopped Mattering](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-12-why-it-stopped.html): age 12. Venice was one of the richest cities on earth and then it was not.
- [Why It Took So Long to Change](https://ktworksheets.com/free/social-12-why-it-took-so-long.html): age 12. Lind proved lemon juice cured scurvy in 1747 and the Navy issued it in 1795 — forty-eight years, and a great many dead sailors in between.

## Free Computing printables

- [Computing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing.html): every free Computing page
- [Computing — Unplugged](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing-04-unplugged.html): ages 4 and up. No screen. Programs written in arrows, run by hand on squared paper: instructions, loops, bugs, decisions, and how a machine holds a number.
- [Putting Things in Order](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing-07-in-order.html): ages 7 and up. You can only ever compare two things at once.
- [A Switch That Flips Another Switch](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing-09-logic-gates.html): ages 9 and up. You know a circuit is a ring and a switch breaks it.
- [Run It With a Pencil](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing-11-run-it-with-a-pencil.html): ages 11 and up. You have used the equals sign for six years to mean that two things are the same, and this year you are using it that way in algebra.
- [How Long Does It Take?](https://ktworksheets.com/free/computing-12-how-long-does-it-take.html): age 12. Every program on this shelf so far either works or does not.

## Free Life Skills printables

- [Life Skills](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life.html): every free Life Skills page
- [Before You Need It](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-04-staying-safe.html): ages 4 and up. Not a list of rules. An address written until it comes out without thinking, three grown-ups named before anybody is missing, the step in crossing a road that everybody drops, and the picture of a…
- [Feelings, From the Inside](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-06-feelings.html): ages 6 and up. Not a poster of faces to match to words. What a feeling actually is before it has a name, why "excited" and "nervous" are the same body, why naming it precisely is the thing that turns it down, and…
- [Doing What the Paper Asks](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-07-following-directions.html): ages 7 and up. The skills every other sheet on this shelf requires and none of them teaches.
- [How You Get Fooled](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-07-online-safety.html): ages 7 and up. Not a list of rules. Why that video was next, why that person is so pleased with a bottle of shampoo, why every scam asks for the same four things whatever story it tells — and what a photo gives away…
- [Time You Have To Read](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-07-signs-and-forms.html): ages 7 and up. A bus timetable, an opening-hours sign, and two things in one oven that have to be ready together. Reading a clock is grade 1. Working backwards from a time you cannot move is not on the shelf at all.
- [Money You Actually Spend](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-07-spending-money.html): ages 7 and up. One transaction, end to end: what it costs, what you handed over, what you should get back — and then the part nobody teaches, which is checking that you got it. Some of these receipts are wrong.
- [How Learning Works, at Eight](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-08-how-learning-works.html): age 8. Reading it again feels like learning. It mostly is not, and this pack proves that on the child rather than telling them — they predict their own score twice, turn the page over, and find out.
- [Money That Waits](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-10-saving-up.html): age 10. At seven, money was one transaction and the change in your hand.
- [How Learning Works](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-11-how-learning-works.html): ages 11 and up. Why rereading feels like learning and is not, and eleven other things nobody is taught. Every sheet tests it on you rather than telling you.
- [Why You Saw That](https://ktworksheets.com/free/life-11-why-you-saw-that.html): age 11. A feed is not a list of what is best, or newest, or most true.

## Free Art printables

- [Art](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art.html): every free Art page
- [Things to Make From What You Have](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-04-crafts.html): ages 4 and up. Not a craft blog. Every build here is made from what is already in the house, needs no special trip and nothing sharper than scissors — and every one of them teaches one thing about why it works.
- [Drawing](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-04-drawing.html): ages 4 and up. Drawing taught as looking rather than talent: copy a grid square by square, finish the mirrored half, build a cat out of two circles — and one page where there is no right answer at all.
- [Origami](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-04-origami.html): ages 4 and up. Squares printed with their creases: the kite base, a box made without glue, a fortune teller to fill in, and a cup that holds water.
- [Paper Planes](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-04-paper-planes.html): ages 4 and up. Print it, fold it, throw it — then measure the throw and work out what actually made it fly further.
- [Things to Make on a Wet Saturday](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-04-projects.html): ages 4 and up. The projects that are not paper. A sock puppet with a mouth that really works, rocks that turn into a story, a jar with a world growing in it, tubes taped down a door for marbles to fall through.
- [Drawing: Light, Form and Perspective](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-08-drawing-seeing.html): ages 8 and up. The second half of drawing, which was filed at age four with the first half and is not for a four-year-old.
- [Things to Make That Move](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-08-projects-mechanism.html): ages 8 and up. The projects with a mechanism in them: a marble run, a mobile that has to balance, a flexagon that turns inside out, a spinning disc that mixes two pictures into one.
- [Things to Make That Measure Something](https://ktworksheets.com/free/art-10-projects-measuring.html): ages 10 and up. Four instruments, built from what is in the house: a sundial, a rain gauge, a weather vane and a pinhole camera.

## Free Music printables

- [Music](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music.html): every free Music page
- [Loud, Quiet, Fast, Slow](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music-04-making-sounds.html): ages 4 and up. Before a sound is long or short it is loud or quiet, and fast or slow — the two things a four-year-old can already do with their whole body without being taught anything.
- [Long, Short, High, Low](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music-05-beat.html): ages 5 and up. Music before any of it is written down. A sound is long or short, and a row of them is a rhythm you can clap.
- [Music You Can Count](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music-07-counting.html): ages 7 and up. Not a keyboard diagram and not the names of the lines of the stave.
- [Time Across, Pitch Up](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music-10-time-across-pitch-up.html): ages 10 and up. Written music is a graph, and once somebody says so there is almost nothing left to memorize.
- [Why There Are Twelve Notes](https://ktworksheets.com/free/music-11-why-twelve-notes.html): age 11. At seven you halved a string and the note went up an octave.

## Free Games printables

- [Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games.html): every free Games page
- [Both Hands at Once](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-00-both-hands.html): any age. A row of hand shapes for your left hand and a different row for your right, read left to right at the same speed.
- [Puzzles](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-00-puzzles.html): any age. Word searches, sudoku, mazes, crosswords and nonograms, with dot-to-dots and mandalas for a quieter twenty minutes.
- [At the Same Table](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-00-two-at-a-table.html): any age. One picture, one question, two doors into it.
- [Pencil and Paper Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-04-pencil.html): ages 4 and up. The games you already know, printed properly — and the versions of them that are still interesting on the tenth go.
- [The Treasure Hunt](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-04-treasure-hunt.html): ages 4 and up. A hunt round your own house: eight clues, each one telling you where the next is hidden, ending at a certificate.
- [Kindergarten Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-05-kinder.html): age 5. Print once and keep: sound bingo, number pairs, board games for two.
- [Grade 1 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-06-grade1.html): age 6. Two-player practice: fact races, word building, board games.
- [Grade 2 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-07-grade2.html): age 7. Two-player practice for regrouping, money and word study.
- [Grade 3 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-08-grade3.html): age 8. Practice that does not look like practice: puzzles and two-player games.
- [Grade 4 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-09-grade4.html): age 9. Two-player and self-checking practice for the year.
- [Grade 5 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-10-grade5.html): age 10. Two-player and self-checking practice for the year.
- [Grade 6 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-11-grade6.html): age 11. Self-checking practice for the year — the maze marks itself.
- [Grade 7 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-12-grade7.html): age 12. Self-checking practice for the year — the maze marks itself.
- [Grade 8 Games](https://ktworksheets.com/free/games-13-grade8.html): age 13. Self-checking practice for the year — the maze marks itself.

## Free Coloring printables

- [Coloring](https://ktworksheets.com/free/colouring.html): every free Coloring page
- [Pictures to Color](https://ktworksheets.com/free/colouring-00-pictures.html): any age. Drawn pictures to color in, one to a page, grouped by what they are — animals, birds, dinosaurs, things that go, food, fairytale.
- [Scenes to Color](https://ktworksheets.com/free/colouring-00-scenes.html): any age. Coloring pages with something going on in them — a farm, a high street, a pond cut through so you can see under the water, a pirate ship.

## Free Spanish printables

- [Spanish](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish.html): every free Spanish page
- [Five Sounds, Before You Can Read Any of Them](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-04-listening.html): ages 4 and up. Spanish has five vowel sounds and it never changes them, which is easier ear-training than English can offer a four-year-old — in English the letter a says four different things and nothing on the…
- [Five Vowels That Never Change](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-06-vowels.html): ages 6 and up. The one thing about Spanish that is easier than English, taught on its own to a child in the middle of English phonics.
- [Eight Colors, Then Use Them](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-07-colours.html): ages 7 and up. The one Spanish topic everybody sells, built the way it should be: the eight words are given away in a key at the top, because they cannot be worked out and pretending otherwise wastes the page — and…
- [Spanish: Words You Already Own](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-07-first-words.html): ages 7 and up. Not colors and numbers to match to pictures.
- [Numbers That Say What They Are](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-08-numbers.html): ages 8 and up. Not numbers to match to pictures of apples.
- [Spanish You Already Know](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-09-first.html): ages 9 and up. Not colors and numbers to match to pictures.
- [Reading Spanish You Were Never Taught](https://ktworksheets.com/free/spanish-12-reading.html): ages 12 and up. A real paragraph, never studied, read with nothing but the vowels, the cognates, the ending rules and a watch for false friends. Plus the verb endings as one system rather than six things to learn.

- [How Chinese Writing Works](https://ktworksheets.com/free/chinese-07-characters.html): ages 7 and up. Not a phrasebook and not twenty pictures of mountains.

## Free Hebrew printables

- [Hebrew](https://ktworksheets.com/free/hebrew.html): every free Hebrew page
- [Where Your Own Alphabet Came From](https://ktworksheets.com/free/hebrew-09-aleph-bet.html): ages 9 and up. Turn a capital A upside down and the two legs become horns over a muzzle, because the letter started as a picture of an ox - and the Hebrew name for it is still aleph, which is still the word for ox.

## Free Arabic printables

- [Arabic](https://ktworksheets.com/free/arabic.html): every free Arabic page
- [Writing That Joins Up](https://ktworksheets.com/free/arabic-09-joined.html): ages 9 and up. Arabic is not written in letters sitting next to each other.

## Free Japanese printables

- [Japanese](https://ktworksheets.com/free/japanese.html): every free Japanese page
- [Three Writing Systems, One Sentence](https://ktworksheets.com/free/japanese-08-three-systems.html): ages 8 and up. A line of Japanese is written in three systems at the same time, and each one has a job.

## Free ASL printables

- [ASL](https://ktworksheets.com/free/asl.html): every free ASL page
- [First Signs, Before They Can Talk](https://ktworksheets.com/free/asl-03-first-signs.html): ages 3 and up. A small child can make a sign months before they can say the word, which means they can ask for a drink instead of crying about it.
- [Say What You Need](https://ktworksheets.com/free/asl-05-what-you-need.html): ages 5 and up. The rung where the child does the signing instead of copying it.
- [A Sign Is Built From Parts](https://ktworksheets.com/free/asl-08-built-from-parts.html): ages 8 and up. Two signs, side by side, that mean completely different things - and only one thing about them is different.
